receive_phase_boundary.finding: Receivecontext8A00 bypasses command equality and treats headerbytes2..5 as metadata. Setupcontexts require bytes2..3 to echo the requested command. The header alone is therefore not an unambiguous unsolicited-frame demultiplexer.
receive_phase_boundary.implementation_implication: Serialize setup exchanges and raw VPW reads with explicit command context; preserve unexpected envelopes and fail on unresolved phase ambiguity rather than project stale setup data as VPW.
